title: AquaPredict M4 Dynamic Rainfall–Susceptibility Synthesis

UNAVAILABLE.definition: Actual usable rainfall observations are absent from source directory.
UNAVAILABLE.behavior: Real-data dynamic synthesis is disabled; static M1 terrain susceptibility displayed with clear status note.

UNVERIFIED DEMONSTRATION.behavior: Interactive timeline slider enabled; persistent prominent demonstration warning displayed throughout interaction.

VERIFIED.definition: Calibrated observations meeting rigorous provenance and sensor QA requirements.
VERIFIED.behavior: Displays verified storm events with explicit point-to-grid spatial representativeness disclosure.

INVALID.definition: Ingested rainfall data fails numeric sanity checks or schema validation.
INVALID.behavior: Rejects data from synthesis; falls back safely to static M1 terrain view with corruption diagnostics.

thresholds.description: No measurable precipitation in the 15-minute interval
Light surface wetting; rates below 0.40 in/hr
Steady precipitation; rates between 0.40 and 1.00 in/hr
Intense downpour; rates at or exceeding 1.00 in/hr

rainfall_provisional_categories.provisional_disclaimer: Rainfall intensity thresholds are provisional display categories for exploratory visualization only; they do not represent verified municipal drainage failure thresholds or certified engineering design return intervals.

spatial_uniformity_assumption.gauge_station: HCFWS Station 1600 (Buffalo Bayou @ Milam St, 29.7642° N, -95.3653° W)
spatial_uniformity_assumption.assumption: Gauge observations from Station 1600 are applied uniformly across the entire 0.97 km² pilot sector.
spatial_uniformity_assumption.limitation: A single point gauge does not establish spatially uniform rainfall. Convective cloudbursts in Houston frequently exhibit significant spatial gradients within 1 km.

scientific_guardrails: No Calibrated Predictions: This synthesis couples static susceptibility with temporal rainfall metrics for screening exploration; it does NOT calculate flood depths, flood volumes, inundation extents, or calibrated flood probabilities.
No Hydraulic Simulation: Subsurface storm pipe network routing, conduit backwater, inlet grate clogging, and bayou stage interactions are not simulated.
Separation of Dimensions: Static terrain susceptibility (EWSI) and dynamic rainfall intensity are maintained as distinct physical dimensions in the data model and UI.
Validation Status: M3 independent validation remains UNAVAILABLE. Dynamic synthesis is an exploratory visualization tool, not a validated flood prediction system.
